name: Viridescent-Arete
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a binary sunset, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls nitrogen controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
